name: Drift Spiral
description: A spiral of dots drifting outward from a single point, cooling through a mixed cool-tone palette.

code.style: --rule: ( @size: @r(4%, 100%); @place: @plot(r: .5); @random(.3) { filter: blur(2px); } background-size: 35%; background-image: @svg( viewBox: 0 0 10 10; circle { r: @r(0, .5); cx, cy: 9 5; fill: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); } ); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
